description: Header file defining endianness utilities, including conversion functions and a class for writing data with specified endianness.

classes.name: EndianOutput
classes.description: A utility class for writing data to an Output with specified endianness.

methods.name: convertToBigEndian
methods.description: Converts a value from native endianness to big endian.

methods.name: convertToLittleEndian
methods.description: Converts a value from native endianness to little endian.
